headline: Argentine Peso Hits 1,565 Low as Street Dollar Widens Gap and Merval Falls
summary: Argentina's official peso fell to a 12-month low of 1,565 per dollar while the informal street dollar rose 1.6% to 1,630. The Merval equity index slipped 0.96% alongside drops in US-listed Argentine bank shares.
why: Argentina's exchange rate gap and currency depreciation directly impact corporate margins, sovereign debt sustainability, and local financial sector performance.
